supersession_reason: V2 was superseded before external review because its movement qualification compared total distance from baseline against the decay-only distance. A genuine gradient opposing weight decay can produce smaller net displacement while still deviating from pure decay. V3 adjudicates exact per-tensor deviation from the exact decay-only counterfactual, retaining no tolerance, no pooled rescue, and preserving frozen F1-B finding-3 discrimination.
movement_criterion: exact elementwise deviation from exact repeated AdamW decay-only counterfactual; zero tolerance; per tensor; no pooled rescue
